key_npc: Jhalmuk, an oni disguised as a wounded traveler seeking refuge
situation: The party discovers a ruined tower where a small band of corrupted knights is performing a blood ritual over stolen relics. The ritual is nearly complete, and the knights will become something worse if undisturbed.

centerpiece.description: In the tower's center, an ancient stone altar glows with sickly crimson light. Three corrupted knights stand around it, chanting in a language that makes the air taste of copper and ash.
centerpiece.mechanic: The altar channels necrotic energy. Any creature that ends its turn within 10 feet must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 necrotic damage.
centerpiece.player_exploit: Shattering the altar requires 3 successful melee attacks (AC 16, 15 HP). Breaking it immediately ends the ritual and forces a concentration check on all chanting creatures.

disguised_as: a travel-worn figure in tattered robes with fresh wounds that weep black ichor beneath torn bandages
